sources.source_name: CoinMarketCap connected global market metrics snapshot
sources.purpose: Cross-check 24h crypto total, spot and derivatives volume fields and their units before calculating market liquidity or ratios
sources.reliability_limits: Mixed-frequency data; definitions and units may not be additive; no snapshot identifier beyond daily label and no synchronized derivatives endpoint timestamp.

sources.source_name: CoinMarketCap connected global derivatives metrics snapshot
sources.purpose: Independent within-provider volume, OI, funding and BTC liquidation cross-check
sources.reliability_limits: No explicit timestamp; blended funding unit/method unspecified; volume total may use a different scope; do not combine with market-wide spot figures without reconciliation.

learnings.title: Do not compute crypto spot/derivatives ratios from unreconciled CMC global volume fields
learnings.claim: On 25 October 2026 the connected CoinMarketCap global metrics snapshot reported 24h total crypto volume 54.72 B, spot volume 109.4 B and derivatives volume 554.55 B, which cannot be additive parts of the reported total; its separate derivatives endpoint reported 170.67 T total 24h volume. The figures are not a reconciled common-denominator series.
learnings.decision: FINANCE_CMC_VOLUME_DENOMINATOR_GATE: Preserve the two provider snapshots and their distinct units, report data conflict; do not sum total/spot/derivatives or calculate a spot-perpetual ratio from these fields until source definitions, units, timestamps and market scope reconcile. Keep funding/OI as raw contextual fields, not a calibrated bull score.
learnings.next_measurement: At next liquid session compare time-stamped CMC market metrics and derivatives metrics with documented definitions and a second independent derivatives provider; only restore ratios after reconciliation.
failure_history: 25 Oct 2026: market total 54.72 B versus spot 109.4 B and derivatives 554.55 B; separate derivatives total 170.67 T; incompatible as one additive liquidity decomposition.
fallback_history: Show independently labelled raw values with CONFLICT status; set cross-market ratio and calibrated derivatives support N/A.
